entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • UseAzureSql at 170: Contains over a list inside a JSON collection applies JSON_CONTAINS to an nvarchar(max) fragment (error 8116) #39626
  • SQL Server 170: Contains over a Guid/DateTime primitive collection translates to JSON_CONTAINS with a uniqueidentifier/datetime2 argument (error 8116) #39625
  • Regression in 11.0: replacing an owned instance or re-adding an entity with the same key sets unchanged OnAdd properties to null #39617
  • Index created on views do not get scaffolded properly #39616
  • Selecting the latest related entity generates ROW_NUMBER over unrelated rows despite parent filtering #39615
  • MinBy_over_subquery specification test is nondeterministic (tie in Northwind data) #39613
    11.0.1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39624
  • Translate DateTime/DateTimeOffset.AddMicroseconds on SQL Server #39623
    community-contribution

    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.Build.Utilities.Core from 18.0.2 to 18.0.38 #39620
    area-infrastructure
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution, area-harness
  • Translate Join/LeftJoin/RightJoin/FullJoin overloads without a result selector #39612
    community-contribution
